title: Tanvi Sharma Advances to Korea Masters Second Round
indian_angle: Young Indian talent Tanvi Sharma secured a significant win against a Chinese opponent, setting up an all-Indian clash in the next round.
summary: Fresh off her Taipei Open title, Tanvi Sharma defeated China’s Yuan An Qi in the Korea Masters opening round, advancing to face fellow Indian Shriyanshi Valishetty.

title: Garaga-Roy Progress to Men's Doubles Second Round at Korea Masters
indian_angle: The Indian men's doubles pair of Garaga and Roy advanced in the Korea Masters.
summary: Indian men's doubles pair Garaga and Roy entered the second round of the Korea Masters.

title: Gopichand Weighs in on BWF's New 3x15 Scoring System
indian_angle: Legendary Indian coach Pullela Gopichand shares his insights on the BWF's proposed 3x15 scoring system, discussing its potential impact on Indian players.
summary: National coach Pullela Gopichand commented on the BWF's new 3x15 scoring system, stating it would 'wipe off few players, benefit few others' and help manage player workload.

title: Sindhu, Satwik-Chirag Seeded for BWF World Championships
indian_angle: India's top shuttlers PV Sindhu and the men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty have received their seedings for the upcoming BWF World Championships.
summary: PV Sindhu was seeded ninth in women's singles, while Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty were seeded fifth in men's doubles for the BWF World Championships.

title: BAI Announces World Junior Championships 2026 Selection Criteria
indian_angle: Badminton Association of India has released the eligibility and selection criteria for Indian players aiming to participate in the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India issued a circular detailing the player eligibility and selection criteria for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Domestic Ranking Tournaments to Adopt 3x15 Scoring System
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India will implement the new 3x15 scoring system in all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories.
summary: The 3x15 scoring system will be implemented in domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships for U-13, U-15 & U-17 age groups, replacing the current 21x3 format.
